title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a historic early‑68 Dead show, highlighted by a powerful second set dedicated to Neal Cassady.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a clear, well‑mixed soundboard source that surpasses earlier releases (RT2.2). Fans describe the performance as “stunning” and “smokin’,” noting its historical weight as the second Carousel show and the first set of songs after Neal Cassady’s death, with a memorable second‑set dedication. Overall both the music and the audio quality are regarded as top‑tier.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple 5‑star reviews laud both the show’s energy and the superior soundboard mix; only one low‑rating comment concerns access, not performance or audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, improved mix over previous RT2.2 release; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑68 energy with historic first performances; the second set is especially revered for its dedication to Neal Cassady, giving the concert a poignant arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's guitar presence was highlighted as captivating and a major visual highlight of the show.
